patch_description: The current program is a single function that generates a contact plan. By refactoring it into smaller functions, we can separate concerns such as walking, picking up an object, and placing an object. This modular approach will make the code more readable, maintainable, and easier to evolve. Each function will handle a specific part of the task, and the main function will orchestrate these steps. This separation of concerns will also help in debugging and testing individual components.
